description: Use this when demopage_status says the demo link is waiting because the sign-up email is not on the website's domain (a Gmail address, for example). It returns one line to publish on the website and looks for it there; once found, the link turns on without waiting for DemoPage's review. With the user's yes, add the line as the file it names in the website's repository, have the user deploy, then call this again. It changes nothing in the product.
name: demopage_verify_site
title: Verify the website
